functions.name: isFinite
functions.summary: Returns true if passed value is finite. Unlike the global isFinite, Number.isFinite doesn't forcibly convert the parameter to a number. Only finite values of the type number, result in true.

returns.description: true when the value is a finite number, otherwise false.

functions.name: isInteger
functions.summary: Returns true if the value passed is an integer, false otherwise.

returns.description: true when the value is an integer, otherwise false.

functions.name: isNaN
functions.summary: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether a value is the reserved value NaN (not a number). Unlike the global isNaN(), Number.isNaN() doesn't forcefully convert the parameter to a number. Only values of the type number, that are also NaN, result in true.

returns.description: true when the value is NaN, otherwise false.

functions.name: isSafeInteger
functions.summary: Returns true if the value passed is a safe integer.

returns.description: true when the value is a safe integer, otherwise false.

functions.name: parseFloat
functions.summary: Converts a string to a floating-point number.

params.name: string
params.description: A string that contains a floating-point number.

returns.description: The parsed number, or NaN when the string does not start with one.

functions.name: parseInt
functions.summary: Converts A string to an integer.

params.name: string
params.description: A string to convert into a number.

params.name: radix
params.description: A value between 2 and 36 that specifies the base of the number in `string`. If this argument is not supplied, strings with a prefix of '0x' are considered hexadecimal. All other strings are considered decimal.

returns.description: The parsed integer, or NaN when the string does not start with one.

functions.name: toExponential
functions.summary: Returns a string containing a number represented in exponential notation.

params.name: fractionDigits
params.description: Number of digits after the decimal point. Must be in the range 0 - 20, inclusive.

functions.name: toFixed
functions.summary: Returns a string representing a number in fixed-point notation.

params.name: fractionDigits
params.description: Number of digits after the decimal point. Must be in the range 0 - 20, inclusive.

returns.description: The number with fractionDigits digits after the decimal point.

functions.name: toLocaleString
functions.summary: Converts a number to a string by using the current or specified locale.
functions.signature: Number.toLocaleString(locales?: string | string[], options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string

params.name: locales
params.description: A locale string or array of locale strings that contain one or more language or locale tags. If you include more than one locale string, list them in descending order of priority so that the first entry is the preferred locale. If you omit this parameter, the default locale of the JavaScript runtime is used.

params.name: options
params.description: An object that contains one or more properties that specify comparison options.

returns.description: The number formatted for the locale.

lines: toLocaleString(locales?: string | string[], options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string;

functions.name: toPrecision
functions.summary: Returns a string containing a number represented either in exponential or fixed-point notation with a specified number of digits.

params.name: precision
params.description: Number of significant digits. Must be in the range 1 - 21, inclusive.

returns.description: The number with precision significant digits.

functions.name: toString
functions.summary: Returns a string representation of an object.

params.name: radix
params.description: Specifies a radix for converting numeric values to strings. This value is only used for numbers.

returns.description: The number as a string in the given radix.

functions.name: valueOf
functions.summary: Returns the primitive value of the specified object.
